Credits

Credits and licences

The photographs on this website are sample images by the photographers named below. They are not work by Vale & Ember, which is a fictional studio.

Sample photography

Every photograph is released under the CC0 1.0 public domain dedication by its photographer. Each was checked individually on its own Wikimedia Commons page (licence, the author's own-work declaration, and no deletion or copyright notices), then downloaded, cropped where noted, resized and stored with this website. No image is loaded from another site.
